Function InspectFunctions() As String
Dim p As PivotTable,f As PivotField
For Each p In Worksheets(1).PivotTables
Set f=p.DataFields(1)
InspectFunctions=InspectFunctions & p.Name & ":" & f.Name & ":" & CStr(f.Function) & ":" & CStr(p.DataBodyRange.Cells(1,1).Value2) & ";"
Next
End Function
